5. Deviations from spec
- Named method deviation, same shape as TR-C-F: post-images exercised through a scratch ESM load hook, test file run directly with --import (the test imports the modules in-process, so no child-process propagation was needed).
- The `mkdirSyncFn` dependency seam is passed through to the entry points (`{ mkdir: mkdirSyncFn }`) instead of being dropped; no test injects it, behaviour under test is unchanged.
- git diff of a new untracked file is empty, so the "every hunk is mine" check was done as `git status --short` over the exact paths (three new files, the two live files clean) plus the build's single-occurrence anchor assertions.
- No WSL baseline (before) was captured; the briefing asks for wsl-after only, and on POSIX the old mkdir already passed mode 0o700.

6. Open items
- Independent Critic review: pending (only the Elephant dispatches it).
- Ceremony install of both post-images at the live paths: pending; after install, re-run the three captures without --import and expect the after.txt shape.
- Install precondition, win32 (disclosed in the manifest): ensureHardenedPrivateDirectory refuses a pre-existing child that assesses insecure and does not repair it. A checkout whose bootstrap-receipt child was created by the old mkdir under an insecure root can fail every receipt write after install, and with no receipt each dispatched subagent's first Write is refused (GUARD-BOOTSTRAP-RECEIPT-MISSING). Assess and, if needed, re-harden the existing children before installing. The telemetry child fails open to the full-text rendering, so there it is only a cost.
- Per-call cost, win32: the observation site runs on every dispatched-subagent gate decision, so a DACL assessment of root and child now runs per call. Not redesigned.
- Not a closing-allowance handover: the work was complete at the 80 % notice (call 44 of 55); the remaining calls went to the record and this report only.
